title: LongVQU-Eval Challenge:  Long-Term Video Quality Understanding Evaluation
description: A multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on long-term video quality understanding (LVQU) across three hierarchical levels: Local Event Quality Understanding (LQU), Cross-Event Quality Reasoning (CQR), and Global Quality Understanding (GQU). Videos span feature films, documentaries, surveillance, egocentric, instructional, and animated content.
description_zh: 一个多选基准，用于评估大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在三个层级上的长期视频质量理解（LVQU）能力：局部事件质量理解（LQU）、跨事件质量推理（CQR）和全局质量理解（GQU）。视频涵盖故事片、纪录片、监控、自中心视角、教学和动画等内容。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# LongVQU-Eval Challenge

**Evaluating Long-Term Video Quality Understanding of Large Vision-Language Models**

IEEE Signal Processing Society Challenge 2026

## Motivation

Traditional video quality assessment (VMAF, SSIM, PSNR, NR-VQA models) works well on
short clips but cannot reason over long temporal context and accumulate perceptual
degradations evidence across events.
**LongVQU-Eval Challenge** aims to close this gap with a multiple-choice question-answering assessment built on
[LongVQUBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aarna004/LongVQUBench). 

## Hierarchical evaluation

| Level | Name | What models must do |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **LQU** — Local Event Quality Understanding | Detect, localize, classify, and rate the severity of isolated distortion events |
| 2 | **CQR** — Cross-Event Quality Reasoning | Compare and integrate perceptual evidence across multiple distortion events |
| 3 | **GQU** — Global Quality Understanding | Synthesize a holistic quality judgment over the full video |

Within each level, questions are further grouped by `qa_category`
(e.g. Comparison, Cumulative Effect) and `question_type`
(yes-or-no, what, which, how).

## How the challenge works

- **Videos:** Development Phase videos are on
  Hugging Face (`Aarna004/LongVQUBench`, `grouped_tars/<LEVEL>/<Category>/*.tar`);
  Test Phase videos are a separate, currently-unpublished. Please check Data & Submission Format for details.
- **Questions live on Codabench :**  Each phase publishes a `questions.json`
  with the video reference, the question, and its multiple-choice options.
- **Build your model :** Offline (on your own compute)
- **Submit only your predictions :**  CSV format (`question_idx, predicted_option`). 
  See the Data & Submission Format page for the exact format.

Scoring is exact-match accuracy against the hidden ground truth, with no
constraints on your model, framework, or inference setup **(Proprietary,
paid-API-only models are not eligible).**

## Who can participate

Individuals or teams of 1-5. Both academic and industry participants are
welcome.



## Organizers

Arpita Nema (Primary Contact): arpita004@e.ntu.edu.sg

Hanwei Zhu : hanwei.zhu@ntu.edu.sg

Weisi Lin: WSLin@ntu.edu.sg

Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
pages.content_zh:
# LongVQU-Eval 挑战赛

**评估大型视觉语言模型的长期视频质量理解能力**

IEEE信号处理协会挑战赛 2026

## 动机

传统视频质量评估方法（VMAF、SSIM、PSNR、NR-VQA模型）在短视频上表现良好，但无法在长时间上下文上进行推理，也无法跨事件累积感知退化证据。
**LongVQU-Eval挑战赛**旨在通过构建在[LongVQUBench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aarna004/LongVQUBench)基础上的多选问答评估来弥补这一差距。

## 分层评估

| 级别 | 名称 | 模型需要完成的任务 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **LQU** — 局部事件质量理解 | 检测、定位、分类和评定孤立失真事件的严重程度 |
| 2 | **CQR** — 跨事件质量推理 | 比较和整合多个失真事件的感知证据 |
| 3 | **GQU** — 全局质量理解 | 对完整视频进行整体质量判断 |

在每个级别内，问题进一步按`qa_category`（如对比、累积效果）和`question_type`（是/否、什么、哪个、如何）分组。

## 挑战赛运作流程

- **视频：** 开发阶段视频位于Hugging Face（`Aarna004/LongVQUBench`、`grouped_tars/<LEVEL>/<Category>/*.tar`）；测试阶段视频为独立的未公开数据集。请查看数据和提交格式页面了解详情。
- **问题发布在Codabench上：** 每个阶段发布一个`questions.json`文件，包含视频参考、问题和多选选项。
- **构建您的模型：** 离线方式（在您自己的计算环境上）
- **仅提交预测结果：** CSV格式（`question_idx, predicted_option`）。详见数据和提交格式页面的准确格式。

评分为与隐藏真值的完全匹配准确度，对您的模型、框架或推理设置**没有限制**（不允许仅限专有和付费API的模型）。

## 参赛资格

1-5人的个人或团队。欢迎学术和行业参与者。

## 组织者

Arpita Nema（主要联系人）: arpita004@e.ntu.edu.sg

Hanwei Zhu: hanwei.zhu@ntu.edu.sg

Weisi Lin: WSLin@ntu.edu.sg

新加坡南洋理工大学

pages.title: Data & Submission Format
pages.content:
# Data & Submission Format

## Data Batches

| Batch | Size | Videos | Answers public? | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Development (Train)** | 1,200 MCQs | on Hugging Face now | Yes | Codabench `public_data/train/questions.json` (WITH `answer`/`answer_idx`) |
| **Test** | TBA | TBA | No, until challenge ends | Codabench `public_data/test_public/questions.json` (candidates only) |

These are two **independent** annotation batches with non-overlapping
`question_idx` values. The Train batch's answers are public (it's on the
gated Hugging Face repo, so anyone with Hub access can see them). Please treat
any Dev-phase leaderboard score as your pipeline check. The **Test batch determines the final ranking**.

## Where the data lives

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Train videos | Hugging Face: [`Aarna004/LongVQUBench`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aarna004/LongVQUBench) — `grouped_tars/<LEVEL>/<Category>/*.tar`. Requires accepting the dataset's terms + a Hub login. |
| Test videos | **TBD — to be announced on 15 Oct 2026.** <This row will be replaced with the  link>. |
| Train questions **with answers** | Codabench, Development Phase `public_data/train/questions.json` |
| Test questions **without answers** | Codabench, Test Phase `public_data/test_public/questions.json` |



## `questions.json` schema

One entry per question:

```json
{
  "question_idx": 246,
  "video_idx": 1212,
  "hierarchy_category": "CQR",
  "question_type": "yes-or-no",
  "qa_category": "Comparison",
  "question": "Is the perceptual degradation in the first 30 seconds more severe than that between 138.37s and 153.35s?",
  "candidates": ["Yes", "No"],
  "answer": "No",
  "answer_idx": 2
}
```

- `hierarchy_category`: `"LQU"` | `"CQR"` | `"GQU"`
- `candidates`: 2–4 answer options
- `answer` / `answer_idx`: **present in the Development Phase file only.**
  The Test Phase file omits both — you're scored against a hidden copy.
- `video_idx`: matches the video's identifier inside the Hugging Face
  `grouped_tars` archives — use this to locate the right video.

## What you submit

A single **`predictions.csv`** at the root of your submission zip:

```csv
question_idx,predicted_option
246,4
422,2
469,3
```

`predicted_option` is the **1-based index** into that question's
`candidates` array (e.g. answering `"No"` for
`["Yes", "No"]` → `predicted_option = 2`).



**Unanswered `question_idx` values are scored as incorrect, so partial
submissions are allowed but will lower your accuracy.**

| 不含答案的测试问题 | Codabench测试阶段 `public_data/test_public/questions.json` |

## `questions.json`结构

每个问题一条记录：

```json
{
  "question_idx": 246,
  "video_idx": 1212,
  "hierarchy_category": "CQR",
  "question_type": "yes-or-no",
  "qa_category": "Comparison",
  "question": "Is the perceptual degradation in the first 30 seconds more severe than that between 138.37s and 153.35s?",
  "candidates": ["Yes", "No"],
  "answer": "No",
  "answer_idx": 2
}
```

- `hierarchy_category`: `"LQU"` | `"CQR"` | `"GQU"`
- `candidates`: 2-4个答案选项
- `answer` / `answer_idx`: **仅在开发阶段文件中出现**。测试阶段文件省略两者 — 您的得分将根据隐藏副本进行评估。


`predicted_option`是该问题`candidates`数组的**基于1的索引**(例如，对`["Yes", "No"]`回答`"No"` → `predicted_option = 2`)。

**未回答的`question_idx`值将被评分为错误，因此允许部分提交但会降低您的准确率。**

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation

## Metric

**Accuracy**: Exact match between your `predicted_option` and the hidden
`answer_idx`, averaged over all questions in the phase. Unanswered
questions count as incorrect.

The leaderboard also reports accuracy broken out per hierarchy level
(LQU / CQR / GQU) for diagnostic purposes, and the number of questions you
provided an answer for (`# Answered`), but ranking is by **Overall
Accuracy**.

## Leaderboard columns

| Column | Key | Sort |
|---|---|---|
| Overall Accuracy | `accuracy` | desc |
| LQU Accuracy | `lqu_accuracy` | desc |
| CQR Accuracy | `cqr_accuracy` | desc |
| GQU Accuracy | `gqu_accuracy` | desc |
| # Answered | `num_answered` | desc |

Ranking uses `accuracy` as the primary sort key. Ties are broken, in order, by:

1. **Inference time** (lower is better), as reported in the submitted methodology document
2. **Parameter count** (lower is better), as reported in the submitted methodology document

## Submission rule

Each phase uses `Force_Last`: only your most recent successful submission
counts toward your leaderboard position, so resubmitting simply replaces
your prior score rather than stacking multiple ranked entries.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估

## 指标

**准确率**：您的`predicted_option`与隐藏的`answer_idx`的完全匹配，在该阶段的所有问题上求平均。未回答的问题计为错误。

排行榜还报告按层级分类的准确率（LQU / CQR / GQU）用于诊断目的，以及您提供答案的问题数量（`# Answered`），但排名以**整体准确率**为准。

## 排行榜列

| 列 | 键 | 排序 |
|---|---|---|
| 整体准确率 | `accuracy` | 降序 |
| LQU准确率 | `lqu_accuracy` | 降序 |
| CQR准确率 | `cqr_accuracy` | 降序 |
| GQU准确率 | `gqu_accuracy` | 降序 |
| 已回答数 | `num_answered` | 降序 |

排名使用`accuracy`作为主要排序键。同分情况按以下顺序打破：

1. **推理时间**（越低越好），由提交的方法论文中报告
2. **参数数量**（越低越好），由提交的方法论文中报告

## 提交规则

每个阶段使用`Force_Last`：仅您最近一次成功提交计入排行榜排名，因此重新提交将替换您之前的分数而非堆叠多个排名条目。

pages.title: Rules & Timeline
pages.content:
# Rules & Timeline

## Timeline

| Date | Milestone |
|---|---|
| 20 Sep 2026 | Challenge Launch - training data released |
| 15 Oct 2026 | **Registration deadline** - submit Codabench handle + team member names/affiliations (see Registration below) |
| 15 Oct 2026 | Test set release |
| 30 Oct 2026 | Test-set results submission deadline (on Codabench) |
| 4 Nov 2026 | **Methodology report + open-source model weights due - all participants** (report format & weight-hosting instructions TBA) |
| 20 Nov 2026 | Challenge results announcement |
| 30 Nov 2026 | **Top-3 teams only:** camera-ready 4-6 page description of approach + open-source code due |
  
All deadlines are 23:59 AoE unless stated otherwise.

## Registration (due 15 Oct 2026)

Before the Test Phase submission starts, every participant/team must
submit:
- Codabench handle (username)
- Team member name(s) and institutional affiliation(s)

**via a separate registration form** (link to be added). Once submitted, **team membership and
affiliations are locked** and cannot be changed afterward.

## Who can participate

Individuals or teams of **1-5 participants**. Both academic and industry
participants are welcome to register.

## Submission limits (Codabench)

- Development Phase: max 100 submissions total, up to 5 submissions/day 
- Test Phase: max 50 submissions total, up to 4/day. Your **last**
  successful submission (`Force_Last`) is the one that counts for the
  final ranking.

## Model eligibility

Proprietary models (no open-source weights **or** accessed only via a
paid/restricted API, e.g. GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude) are **not eligible**. 

## Methodology report - required for all participants (due 4 Nov)

This is separate from your Codabench prediction submission. Every team
with a scored Test Phase submission must submit a 4-6 page write-up
describing their methodology/architecture. Format and the submission
form/link will be published closer to the deadline. Submissions without
an accompanying report will be removed from the final published
leaderboard before results are archived.



## Model weights

- **All participants** must share the actual model weights used to produce their scored Test Phase predictions with organizers via a **private link** (e.g. a gated Hugging Face repo, private cloud storage, or similar) shared alongside your methodology report. This is for verification only -  confirming no proprietary/banned model was used and that results are reproducible.
- This applies even if you used an unmodified base model; in that case, simply confirm the same public checkpoint already disclosed under Model Eligibility.
- Submissions whose weights are not verifiably shared with organizers by this deadline are subject to the same removal-from-leaderboard consequence as a missing methodology report.


## Additional - The top-3 teams (due 30 Nov)

The top-3-ranked teams additionally submit a **camera-ready** version of
their 4-6 page description (polished for publication) alongside
**open-source code** (training + inference).
pages.content_zh:
# 规则与时间表

## 时间表

| 日期 | 里程碑 |
|---|---|
| 2026年9月20日 | 挑战赛启动 - 发布训练数据 |
| 2026年10月15日 | **报名截止** - 提交Codabench用户名+团队成员名称/所属机构（详见报名部分） |
| 2026年10月15日 | 发布测试集 |
| 2026年10月30日 | 测试集结果提交截止（在Codabench上） |
| 2026年11月4日 | **方法报告+开源模型权重截止 - 全部参赛者**（报告格式及权重托管说明另行通知） |
| 2026年11月20日 | 挑战赛结果发布 |
| 2026年11月30日 | **前3强队伍仅需：** 相机就绪版4-6页方案描述+开源代码截止 |

所有截止时间均为23:59 AoE，除非另有说明。

## 报名（截止2026年10月15日）

在测试阶段提交开始前，每位参赛者/团队必须提交：
- Codabench用户名
- 团队成员名称及所属机构

**通过单独的报名表**（链接后续添加）。提交后，**团队成员和所属机构将被锁定**，之后无法更改。

## 参赛资格

**1-5名参赛者**组成的个人或团队。欢迎学术界和产业界参赛者报名。

## 提交限制（Codabench）

- 开发阶段：最多100次提交总数，每天最多5次
- 测试阶段：最多50次提交总数，每天最多4次。您的**最后一次**成功提交（`Force_Last`）将用于最终排名。

## 模型资格要求

专有模型（无开源权重**或**仅通过付费/受限API访问，例如GPT-4o、Gemini、Claude）**不符合资格**。

## 方法报告 - 全部参赛者必需（截止11月4日）

此项独立于您的Codabench预测提交。每支在测试阶段有评分提交的团队必须提交一份4-6页的说明文档，阐述其方法论/架构。格式及提交表单/链接将在截止前后公布。未附报告的提交将在结果公布前从最终排行榜中移除。

## 模型权重

- **全部参赛者**必须通过**私密链接**（例如受限制的Hugging Face仓库、私密云存储或类似方式）与组织者共享用于生成评分测试阶段预测的实际模型权重。这仅用于验证目的 - 确认未使用专有/禁用模型，且结果可复现。
- 即使您使用了未修改的基础模型，也适用此要求；此情况下，仅需确认已在《模型资格要求》部分披露的相同公开检查点。
- 未在此截止前与组织者可验证地共享权重的提交将面临与缺少方法报告相同的后果 - 从排行榜中移除。

## 追加规定 - 前3强队伍（截止11月30日）

排名前3的队伍需额外提交其4-6页方案描述的**相机就绪版**（已打磨可供发表），以及**开源代码**（训练+推理）。
